name: anonymous_vote
description: Cast a private vote in {0..7} as a member of a depth-16 Poseidon Merkle tree of eligible voters; emit a per-(voter, ballot) nullifier so each voter votes at most once
useCases: One-person-one-vote ballots where the voter stays anonymous
DAO governance votes with double-vote protection via nullifiers

voterSecret.description: Voter's secret. leaf = Poseidon(voterSecret) lives in the voters tree

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

vote.description: Chosen option, in [0, 8). Re-emitted as the public output revealedVote

votersRoot.description: Public Merkle root of all eligible voters

ballotId.description: Identifier of this ballot. Namespaces the nullifier so voters can re-vote in future ballots

nullifier.description: Poseidon(voterSecret, ballotId). Tally contract must reject duplicates

revealedVote.description: The vote in {0..7}, exposed publicly so the tally contract can count it
